document.title: GST: Coherent Core V2
document.author: Ярослав Ісаченков
reviewed_sections: Section 9: Theorem 5, equation (31), proof and scope

coverage.zero_source: n=0 implies B=b*n=0; Lean specializes directly to B=0.
coverage.controls: Measurable real controls with pointwise bounds 0<=u(t)<=U for t>=0.
coverage.initial_states: Arbitrary finite nonnegative real initial states, including zero.
coverage.coefficients: Lean requires eta>0, a>0 and c>=0. This includes the document's positive coefficients. Objective coefficients are not needed for this dynamical result.
coverage.state_limit: omega(t) tends to zero as t tends to positive infinity.
coverage.positive_threshold: For every h>0, eventually omega(t)<h; omega(t)>=h cannot hold for all t>=0.
coverage.integration_domain: Ioi 0 and the document's [0,infinity) integrals agree because the singleton {0} has zero Lebesgue measure.
coverage.proof_difference: The document proves decay by splitting the exponential convolution. Lean derives existence of the limit from the exact balance and half-line integrability, then proves the limit is zero.

scope_limits: The consolidated theorem uses Measurable, pointwise-admissible controls; no separate AEMeasurable formulation is claimed here.
No claim that resource phi necessarily tends to zero.
No claim about physical disappearance of a system.
No optimality or clipping hypothesis is needed.
review_basis: Semantic comparison performed in the conversation using the PDF text and the Lean declarations supplied for stages 167-171. This script records that review and checks its artifact bindings; it does not automatically infer semantic equivalence.
